description: This file defines a React hook 'useColDefs' for generating column definitions for an AG Grid table in a Superset plugin, including functions for data type inference, filter configuration, and column grouping.

methods.name: getValueRange
methods.description: Calculates the range of values for a given column, considering positive/negative alignment.

methods.name: getCellDataType
methods.description: Infers the data type ('number', 'date', 'boolean', 'text') for a column based on its dataType.

methods.name: getFilterType
methods.description: Determines the filter type ('agNumberColumnFilter', 'agTextColumnFilter', 'agDateColumnFilter') based on column dataType.

methods.name: dateFilterValueGetter
methods.description: Retrieves filter value for temporal columns, handling DateWithFormatter objects with null input.

methods.name: getHeaderLabel
methods.description: Generates the header label for a column, considering original labels, custom names, and display icons.
